candidateRule: For each language, GitHub repository search (language filter, sorted by stars, descending, first 40 results on 2026-11-22), skipping archived repositories, repositories already used by any earlier FixMap cohort, and repositories whose name or description matches /awesome|tutorial|interview|course|book|roadmap|list of|collection|cheat|guide|learn|resources|example|leetcode|algorithm|exercise|demo|sample|homework|free |projects|system design|prompts?|papers/i. The first 15 survivors per language are listed in star order. This cohort continues the same frozen Java list from polyglot-heldout at the first candidate that cohort never queried; the case rule, limits and order are unchanged.
